source: same verified UNSW IoT Attack Traces and V41/V42 sample protocol
purpose: Repair V42 policy-calibration failure without changing its forecasting architecture: replace clipped empirical-percentile anomaly scores with continuous benign-calibrated robust scores and use tie-safe strict threshold semantics.
claim_scope: zero-day-like unseen-family early progression forecasting after the first observable malicious network change; not prediction before the first malicious packet and not universal zero-day prediction
sample_protocol: identical to V41/V42: four one-minute rows ending at current minute, 240-second continuation target, non-overlapping 30-minute device-time block split, locked-family exclusion

representation.base: exact V42 V37 36D scale-free fraction derivatives
representation.environment_normalization: exact V42 per-device robust median/IQR fitted on benign TRAIN blocks only
representation.supervised_lane: exact V42 HGB known-progression head and calibration
representation.unknown_isolation_raw: negative IsolationForest decision_function, model fit on benign train only
representation.unknown_shock_raw: exact V42 top-4 mean absolute robust-normalized derivative shock score
representation.continuous_calibration: for each raw anomaly component, subtract benign-calibration median and divide by max(benign-calibration IQR, 1e-6)
representation.unknown_composite: maximum of the two continuous robust-calibrated anomaly components

decision_policy.threshold_estimation: higher quantile of benign policy scores at 1-budget
decision_policy.threshold_comparison: strict greater-than; equality is non-alert to prevent quantile tie inflation
decision_policy.selection: choose first predeclared pair whose combined OR alert has <=1.05% benign FPR on policy data; attack-positive policy outcomes are not used to select budgets or thresholds

comparison: Only the anomaly calibration/threshold semantics change from V42; sample protocol, held-out families, locked families, model classes, representation and FPR/recall gates remain fixed.
final_validation: locked; TcpSynDevice and UdpDevice are not scored by V43 and fresh external validation remains required before any final zero-day-like claim
